exactly_what_is_needed: 1. A network-permitted host, then: python tools/fetch_real_logs.py --no-run
2. pip install -e '.[logs]' for pyulog (installed here: False)
3. Re-run this script; it needs no other change, because fix_type is already plumbed at ulog_source.py:178 and gvalid is a function of fix_type alone.
explicitly_not_done: No simulator run was substituted. The brief forbids simulating and labelling it real, and an unconditional rate from synthetic denial would measure the fault model, not flight.
what_it_would_NOT_yield: q_gvalid | h. The conditioning variable does not exist in an unannotated corpus. See research/wp_c5/Q_GVALID_MEASUREMENT_SPEC.md section 2.
what_it_would_yield: Per-flight gvalid occupancy against applicable (post-arm) time, closure-run count and longest-run length, and the across-flight distribution. Unconditional only.
why: data/real_logs/ contains no .ulg files. The corpus is identified by UUID in data/real_logs_report.json but the files themselves were never committed (gitignored), and review.px4.io is refused by this environment's egress policy.
